svg.title: FlashAttention-4 forward · SM100 kernel structure
svg.desc: Who does the work, which events connect the roles, and when SMEM/TMEM storage can be reused. Warp-role operations, cross-role synchronization, and aligned SMEM/TMEM lifetimes.
svg.text: Who does the work, which events connect the roles, and when SMEM/TMEM storage can be reused.
NVIDIA Blackwell SM100 · path: dense TMA · Q stages: 2 · KV stages: 3 · split-KV: no · tile: N=128, D=Dv=128 · scope: representative 1-CTA steady state
semantic event order · widths are not cycle-accurate
MAINLOOP · REPEAT OVER j (ONE ITERATION SHOWN)
Issue TMA Q/K/V loads into staged SMEM
Issue tcgen05 QK and PV; own TMEM allocation
Same program, staggered behind Q stage 0
Rescale prior O and finalize TMEM O into SMEM
Consume staged SMEM O and publish GMEM output
ON-CHIP MEMORY LIFETIMES · SAME EVENT AXIS
sQ[0] · held until the K/V loop exits
Q₀ · loaded once; reused by every Q₀Kᵢ
sQ[1] · held until the K/V loop exits
Q₁ · loaded once; reused by every Q₁Kᵢ
logical K/V views share this physical stage
Vⱼ₊₁ · carried into the next iteration
next K stage prefetched during current compute
Kⱼ₊₁ · carried into the next iteration
row max + row sum for two Q stages
S offset 0; P view begins at S + N/2
S offset N; P view begins at S + N/2
• sQ and sO use separate physical allocations in this configuration (when D=128, Dv=128, split-KV=no); alternate: sQ and sO alias for D=192 with Dv≥64, or split-KV with Dv≥128.
• Index contract: prologue primes K₀/V₀; at mainloop entry they are the j=0 instance of symbolic Kⱼ/Vⱼ; steady state prefetches Kⱼ₊₁/Vⱼ₊₁.
• TMEM offsets: S=[0,N], P=S+N/2 (packed view), O=2N+stage×Dv; N=Dv=128 in this view.
• The 3-stage K/V ring overlaps current Vⱼ consumption with Kⱼ₊₁/Vⱼ₊₁ prefetch; slot 0 is shown reusing Kⱼ storage for Vⱼ₊₁.
solid sync = ready · dashed sync = released/reusable · adjacent bars in one row = physical alias
